item.title: Gemini Aims for $2.22 Billion U.S. IPO - Traders Log
item.description: Gemini, the crypto exchange founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, is targeting a $2.22 billion valuation in its planned U.S. IPO. The company aims to raise up to $317 million by listing on Nasdaq under the ticker GEMI, with Goldman Sachs and Citigroup as lead underwriters.

item.title: Trump-Backed Bitcoin Miner “American Bitcoin” to List on Nasdaq - Traders Log
item.description: American Bitcoin, a cryptocurrency mining and holding company backed by former U.S. President Donald Trump’s sons and Canadian miner Hut 8, is preparing to list on the Nasdaq exchange under the ticker ABTC, the company said on Tuesday.

item.title: Robinhood, AppLovin Shares Jump on S&P 500 Inclusion - Traders Log
item.description: Robinhood and AppLovin shares jumped on Monday after S&P Dow Jones Indices announced they will join the S&P 500 on Sept. 22, replacing Caesars Entertainment and MarketAxess Holdings.

item.title: Webull Expands into Europe with Amsterdam Headquarters
item.description: Webull has launched its European operations with a new headquarters in Amsterdam, starting in the Netherlands and planning expansion across the EU to bring commission-free trading and advanced tools to retail investors.

item.title: Nebius Group Soars After $17.4 Billion Microsoft AI Deal
item.description: Nebius Group shares surged after signing a $17.4 billion deal with Microsoft to provide GPU-based AI infrastructure, positioning the Amsterdam-based firm as a major player in the rapidly growing AI cloud market.

item.title: Silver Rallies to Fresh 14-Year Highs - Traders Log
item.description: Silver surged sharply today, pushing to levels not seen since May 2011. The white metal broke past key resistance, reaching fresh multi-year highs amid bullish momentum and rising investor interest.

item.title: Robinhood Stock Soars to Record Highs on Prediction Market Boom
item.description: Robinhood stock hit record highs today, driven by booming prediction markets and S&P 500 momentum, but risks of volatility and regulation remain.

item.title: Tether Joins Team Juventus: When Crypto Meets the Beautiful Game - Traders Log
item.description: Tether, the company behind USDT, has become a major shareholder in Juventus, aiming to blend blockchain innovation with football tradition while seeking a stronger role in the club’s governance and future.

item.title: Edgeful Review: The Tool Bringing Institutional-Grade Market Research to Retail Traders - Traders Log
item.description: Edgeful is a statistics-based trading platform that positions itself as a personal financial analyst, transforming raw market data into actionable insights for traders. Rather than relying on intuition, Edgeful provides probability-based strategies backed by historical data analysis.
